part.text:
The "should support HTTPS protocol" timeout is pre-existing (fails on unmodified code too — environment-related), so the fix is validated. 

**Change** in `lib/helpers/isAbsoluteURL.js:18`: the regex `/^([a-z][a-z\d+\-.]*:)?\/\//i` → `/^([a-z][a-z\d+\-.]*:)\/\//i`, so protocol-relative URLs (`//host`) are no longer treated as absolute. With a `baseURL` set, they're now combined with it instead of bypassing it — closing the SSRF vector (CVE-2024-39338).
